body.name: \(\mathcal M_{p,q}(G)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{p,q}(G)=\{(F,\Lambda^{(0)},\delta,v,t)\in\mathbb R^{pq+2q^2+2q}:2\le p<q,\ G\text{ is a DAG on }V\text{ in the displayed topological order},\operatorname{rank}(F)=p,\ F\text{ has nonzero pairwise-noncollinear columns},\Lambda^{(0)}_{ij}\ne0\Longleftrightarrow j\to i\text{ is an edge of }G,\operatorname{supp}(\delta_k)=\operatorname{pa}_G(k),\Lambda^{(0)}_{kj}+\delta_{kj}\ne0,\ v_i>0,\ t_i>0\}\). This positive-support semialgebraic ambient domain includes the variance-neutral hyperplanes \(t_i=v_i\). All equalities, strict inequalities, closures, relative interiors, and chambers below use the Euclidean relative topology of this ambient set or of a stated semialgebraic subset.
